title: Invariant measures for half-space geometric LPP: classification and the one force--one solution principle
summary: We prove a complete characterization of the extremal invariant measures for half-space geometric last-passage percolation with an arbitrary boundary parameter. This is the first result of its kind for a model in the KPZ universality class that has boundary effects and an unbounded domain. A description of a class of invariant measures was previously given in a work of Barraquand and Corwin, where it was conjectured that these should comprise all extremal invariant measures.
